independent_reference_scope.implementation: Standard-library Decimal and Fraction only; Decimal precisions 100 and 160. No source SVD, NumPy, SciPy or production imports.
independent_reference_scope.geometry_boundary: Rounded captured areas, lengths, centres, points and source topology are supplied inputs. This does not independently generate or qualify those quantities.
independent_reference_scope.incidence: Construct endpoint entries and ordered face-edge signs independently from supplied topology. Duplicate directed matches remain unresolved diagnostics; no canonical tie-index claim.
independent_reference_scope.graph_pseudoinverse: For bounded grounded incidence, construct the connected-component gauge projector P and solve (A.T*A + P)^(-1)*A.T using Decimal elimination. Handle transposed incidence independently.
independent_reference_scope.graph_rank_separation: With n <=32 columns, an anchored path bound or mean-zero path bound gives nonzero sigma >=1/(n+1); sigma_max <=sqrt(2*maximum_degree). Require the resulting conservative relative gap to exceed 1000 times the pinned default rcond.
independent_reference_scope.other_pseudoinverses: Use exact constant-matrix rank-zero/rank-one formulas or independently invert a bounded square full-rank matrix. Bound its relative singular gap by 1/sqrt(norm1(A)*normInf(A)*norm1(Ainv)*normInf(Ainv)).
independent_reference_scope.cutoff: Pin NumPy 2.5.3 linalg/_linalg.py and its AST default branch rcond=1e-15 in the source map. The native oracle authenticates the loaded package source. Never silently override rcond.
independent_reference_scope.rank_refusal: Unsupported or unresolved rank domains retain their report and fail a declared numerical check. No independent truncated-SVD result is claimed.
independent_reference_scope.identities: Independently calculate all four Moore-Penrose identities on the captured rounded A and Aplus.
independent_reference_scope.smoothing: Assemble the metric-weighted matrix from exact rational representations of the captured input floats, solve independently in the resolved rank domain, and compare the full resulting coordinates.
independent_reference_scope.other_checks: Independent matrix/vector products, quality squared distances, normalized energy and exact refinement copies. Energy branch disagreements are diagnostics and do not change native selection.
independent_reference_scope.dimensional_products: Retain term1 and LL products as diagnostics in m^-2 without inventing an absolute accuracy budget for them. Assert dimensionless term2 and coordinate products.

proposed_tolerances.native: Exact full typed cache, layouts, events, point IDs and full RNG.
proposed_tolerances.failure_policy: Preserve and report failed fixtures and budgets. Do not shift fixtures, widen tolerances, change native primitives or relabel failures to pass.
